reasoning_input.question_text: Find all complex roots of the equation z³ = 8i, expressing your answers in polar form r e^(iθ) with -π < θ ≤ π.

student_steps.content: Write 8i in exponential form: 8i = 8 e^(i (π/2 + 2kπ)) for k = 0, 1, 2
Apply De Moivre's theorem: z_k = (8 e^(i (π/2 + 2kπ)))^(1/3) = 2 e^(i (π/6 + 2kπ/3))

steps.description: Express 8i in general exponential form 8 e^(i(π/2 + 2kπ))
Apply fractional power rule z_k = 2 e^(i(π/6 + 2kπ/3))
Find first root z₀ = 2 e^(i π/6)
Find third root in valid principal range z₂ = 2 e^(-i π/2)
